direct_and_group_chats.name: Incident Bridge - Auth Outage
direct_and_group_chats.yesterday_discussion_summary: Yesterday in 'Incident Bridge - Auth Outage', Marcus Vance reported authentication token signing latency spikes exceeding 800ms. David Kim isolated the issue to an expired intermediate certificate on Envoy edge proxies. After deploying the updated trust bundle, token verification latencies dropped back to 12ms.

meetings.name: Cloud Architecture Review
collaborative_notes: Action Item: Alex Chen to finalize GKE Ingress controller security benchmarks by Oct 5.
Decision: Approved migrating internal services from Consul service mesh to Istio ambient mesh.
Follow-up: Marcus Vance to review mTLS certificate rotation latency.
meetings.transcript_summary: In the meeting transcript, Alex Chen presented the hybrid multi-cloud ingress architecture. Marcus Vance raised concerns regarding egress bandwidth costs between AWS and GCP, which David Kim confirmed is mitigated via Cloud Interconnect. The team unanimously approved transitioning to ambient mesh.
